scripts.start: concurrently  "lerna run start --scope=@aptero/aptero-meet" "lerna watch --ignore '@aptero/aptero-meet' -- lerna run build"
scripts.pull: cross-env git pull && git submodule update --recursive --remote --merge && git submodule foreach --recursive "git fetch origin main && git checkout main && git merge origin/main || true"
scripts.pw:debug:run: cross-env CI=1 PW_PORT=53000 PWDEBUG=1 npx playwright ../../test --config ./test/playwright-teams.config.js StaticTab.test.ts
scripts.pw:debug:serve: cross-env NODE_ENV=development PW_PORT=53000 yarn run dev
scripts.ci:coverage:serve: cross-env NODE_ENV=development USE_BABEL_PLUGIN_ISTANBUL=1 webpack --stats-error-details --config webpack.config.js && npx http-server dist --silent -p 53000 --ssl --cert ./certs/cert.pem --key ./certs/key.pem
scripts.ci:coverage:serve:run: cross-env CI=true START_SERVER_AND_TEST_INSECURE=1 start-server-and-test ci:coverage:serve https://127.0.0.1:53000 ci:coverage:playwright:run
scripts.ci: cross-env yarn run clean && yarn run ci:coverage:serve:run && nyc --no-clean yarn --version

scripts-info.start: Use to start dev on the project
